content.text: Almost. Health Canada's guidance is to start solids around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months now. Many families begin in the weeks just before or after that point. He's ready when he sits with little support, holds his head steady and shows interest in your food. Until then, breast milk or formula is still all he needs. For now, let him watch you eat and give him a clean spoon to hold and mouth. The usual first foods are iron-rich ones, like iron-fortified cereal or well-cooked, mashed or pureed meat or beans. Confirm the timing with your provider or public health.
